# bun audit high-severity allowlist
#
# `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `audit` job runs:
#   bun audit --audit-level=high $(this file, one --ignore=<GHSA-id> per line)
# Any HIGH or CRITICAL advisory NOT listed below fails CI immediately.
#
# Every line here is a temporary, individually-justified exception for a
# finding that existed on the date it was added — not a blanket suppression.
# Do NOT add an entry without a justification, and do NOT bump the date on
# review without re-verifying the reasoning still holds.
#
# Each entry must state: the advisory, the dependency path, why no fix is
# adoptable, why it is not exploitable in this codebase's usage, and a
# tracking issue. "Upgrading is inconvenient" is not a reason. An entry with
# no stated reason is indistinguishable from suppressing a real finding.
#
# ⚠️ An advisory's range can be EXTENDED after publication, which silently
# re-vulnerablises an `overrides` floor that was set to the then-fixed
# version (#1581: `seroval: ">=1.6.0"` against a later `<= 1.6.0` range was
# pinning the vulnerable version). Verify target versions against the
# upstream advisory's `first_patched_version`, never against a changelog or
# a recommendation (#632) — and never bump past an advisory's range when the
# new version does not actually contain the fix (see http-cache-semantics
# below for a live example of exactly that trap).
#
# Review cadence: re-audit and prune stale entries whenever a listed
# package is intentionally upgraded, and at least quarterly otherwise.
# Follow-up tracking issue: https://github.com/Llamenos-Hotline/llamenos-platform/issues/649
#
# Format: GHSA-id  # added YYYY-MM-DD by <who> — package — reachability — reasoning

# --- vite: nested copies under vitest and astro (dev-server-only) ---
# The DIRECT devDependency is on `^8.0.16` and is out of range for all three.
# These findings are nested copies — vitest > vite@7.3.x and astro > vite@8.0.x.
# No fix is adoptable: bun/npm `overrides` are flat, and the npm EOVERRIDE rail
# in tests/manifest-npm-coherence.test.ts requires an override on a direct
# dependency's name to be byte-identical to the direct range — which would force
# vitest's and astro's own vite ranges onto 8.x. Fixing them means bumping
# vitest and astro themselves.
# Reachability: all three are exploitable only against a running `vite dev`
# server (fs.deny bypass via queries / Windows alternate paths, dev-server
# websocket arbitrary file read). CI builds via `vite build`; production serves
# the prebuilt bundle from the Tauri shell. The nested copies belong to the test
# runner and the marketing-site build, neither of which starts a dev server.
GHSA-v2wj-q39q-566r  # added 2026-09-11, re-justified 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo — vite (nested under vitest/astro) — dev-server-only fs.deny bypass, not exercised by build/preview; flat overrides cannot reach a nested copy of a direct dep — tracked in #1583
GHSA-p9ff-h696-f583  # added 2026-09-11, re-justified 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo — vite — same path and reasoning (dev-server websocket file read) — tracked in #1583
GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff  # added 2026-09-11, re-justified 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo — vite — same path and reasoning (Windows alternate paths; Linux/macOS dev + CI unaffected) — tracked in #1583

# --- nanoid: the 5.x line under @scalar/types (OpenAPI docs UI) ---
# Two major lines coexist. The 3.x copy is on 3.3.20 (fixed). The live finding
# is @scalar/types > nanoid@5.1.6, which needs 5.1.16. No fix is adoptable: a
# flat override cannot express a per-major floor — `>=5.1.16` would drag
# postcss's `^3.3.12` onto ESM-only nanoid 5, and a 3.x floor would break
# @scalar. @scalar/types@0.23.0 (latest) still declares `^5.1.6`.
# Reachability: @scalar/hono-api-reference mounts the OpenAPI reference UI in
# apps/worker; nanoid there generates internal, non-security-sensitive UI ids and
# is never called with an attacker-controlled, negative or zero size argument,
# which both advisories require.
GHSA-28wg-ghj8-5hjv  # added 2026-09-11, re-justified 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo — nanoid 5.x (@scalar/hono-api-reference prod dep, docs UI ids) — no attacker-controlled size argument; flat overrides cannot express a per-major floor — tracked in #1583
GHSA-xwg4-73v4-xw9w  # added 2026-09-11, re-justified 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo — nanoid 5.x — same path and reasoning — tracked in #1583

# extract-zip (GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv, GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3) and deepmerge-ts
# (GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx) entries REMOVED 2026-10-10 (#1769): webdriverio 9 → 10
# moves @puppeteer/browsers to ^3.2.1 (extract-zip path gone, replaced by
# modern-tar) and @wdio/utils to ^10 which declares deepmerge-ts ^8.0.0 —
# both advisories are cleared by the resolved tree, not suppressed.

# --- http-cache-semantics: astro (marketing site build, site/) — NO UPSTREAM FIX ---
# GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp covers `http-cache-semantics` through 4.2.0 and the
# GitHub advisory records no patched version. 4.3.0 IS PUBLISHED AND IS NOT A
# FIX: diffing the 4.2.0 and 4.3.0 tarballs, index.js changes only a `Vary: *`
# matching bug, adds a status() accessor and touches JSDoc — the max-stale /
# security-zeroed logic the advisory cites (index.js L425-441, L603-623) is
# byte-identical. Because the advisory range is `<= 4.2.0`, bumping to 4.3.0
# would silence `bun audit` without fixing anything. DO NOT bump this to
# silence the audit; wait for a real fix.
# Reachability: one consumer, one call site — astro's build-time remote-asset
# cache (astro/dist/assets/build/remote.js). The flaw needs a shared multi-user
# cache serving requests; this is a single-tenant cache on the build machine,
# over URLs committed to this repo. The deployed static site on Cloudflare Pages
# ships no copy of this package and evaluates no max-stale at request time.
GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp  # added 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo — http-cache-semantics (astro, site/ build tool) — no upstream fix exists (4.3.0 is NOT a fix, verified by source diff); build-time single-tenant cache, unreachable from any request — tracked in #1579

# --- braces: chokidar / micromatch dev+build tooling — NO UPSTREAM FIX ---
# GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm covers `braces` <= 3.0.3 with no patched version, and
# npm `latest` IS 3.0.3 — the newest release is the vulnerable one, so no
# overrides floor can be written. Routing around it is also unavailable:
# chokidar@4 dropped braces/micromatch, but @tanstack/router-plugin (a direct
# dependency) declares chokidar@^3 and chokidar 4 removed glob support, so the
# major would break Vite route-file watching; and micromatch itself has no fix,
# so the shadcn / playwright-bdd / jest-message-util paths persist regardless.
# Reachability: every path is build-, dev- or test-time glob expansion over
# patterns written in this repository (Vite/TanStack route watching, Mocha and
# WebdriverIO spec discovery, shadcn CLI matching, playwright-bdd feature
# discovery, Jest message formatting). The DoS needs an attacker-supplied
# deeply-nested brace pattern; no consumer here is handed a pattern from a
# request or any untrusted source, and braces is absent from the worker's
# production closure and from every shipped client bundle.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm  # added 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo — braces (chokidar via @tanstack/router-plugin/wdio/mocha; micromatch via shadcn/playwright-bdd/jest-message-util; astro) — no upstream fix exists (npm latest 3.0.3 is itself in range); build/dev/test-time glob patterns from this repo only — tracked in #1580
